summary: E13 Driver Leaderboard + Revenue-per-Trip feature testing completed. All backend APIs (41/41 tests) and frontend components passed successfully. Feature fully functional with proper RBAC enforcement.

Backend: Revenue-per-trip calculation correct (fleet.revenue_per_trip = revenue/trips)
Backend: Leaderboard sorted by revenue descending with sequential ranks 1..N
Backend: GET /api/reports/summary includes 'drivers_report' key with correct data
Backend: GET /api/reports/drivers/export?format=excel returns xlsx file (>800 bytes, correct content-type)
Backend: GET /api/reports/drivers/export?format=pdf returns PDF file (>800 bytes, correct content-type)
Backend: Period filter works - GET /api/reports/drivers?period=2020-01 returns empty (fleet.trips=0, drivers=[])
